🔧 Issues Found & Resolved During Setup

✓
dotenv path resolution Environment variables not loading when server was started from project root. Fixed by using path.join(__dirname, '.env') in dotenv config.
✓
Duplicate wallet adapter initialization AppKitProvider.tsx was creating a second SolanaAdapter instance while App.tsx already called createAppKit(). Removed the redundant provider wrapper.
✓
CORS preflight blocked (Express 5 incompatibility) helmet() was applied before cors(), blocking all OPTIONS requests. Fixed middleware order and updated wildcard syntax incompatible with Express 5 + path-to-regexp.
✓
import.meta in Node.js context SDK/programId.ts used import.meta (Vite/browser syntax) breaking ts-node execution. Replaced with a try/catch using Function() to safely handle both environments.
✓
New endpoint: POST /api/verify-tx Added transaction verification endpoint that confirms existence, success status, and wallet involvement against Devnet. Includes Joi validation and clean JSON responses.

Known Issue — Release Payment Step

⚠ Open Issue

Platform not initialized on Devnet

The Release Payment step failed with a Platform not initialized error. The smart contract's release_milestone instruction requires a platformConfig PDA account to exist on-chain, which is created by a one-time initialize_platform call that was never executed on this deployment.

Root cause: The program at Hzmfuj1scfA4UWNsKu82MopCsrvUEBGfeAtB79xYfXzK has not had its platform initialized. The SDK includes a ready-to-use script at solana-program/SDK/init-platform.ts specifically for this.

  • Fix: Run npx ts-node SDK/init-platform.ts from solana-program/ using the admin keypair that deployed the program. This is a one-time operation.
  • Alternatively: If the deployer keypair is unavailable, redeploy the program and initialize the platform in the same flow.
  • Impact: All steps prior to release (job creation, proposal, on-chain contract, escrow funding, milestone submission) work correctly end-to-end. Only the final payout is blocked by this initialization requirement.
